description: Update the summary of a thread (markdown). With a section, adds to that section only (or replaces it with replaceSection); without one, replaces the whole summary, so keep what is still true.

content.description: The new summary, or the text to add to the section (markdown)

paths.description: Files or directories this thread is about, used to flag the summary when they change

replaceSection.description: Replace the section instead of adding to it (use it for state and next-steps)

section.description: Only update this section: decisions, constraints, state, open-questions or next-steps

threadId.description: Thread ID to update (defaults to active thread)

name: summary_update
title: Update thread summary
